text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Trainer-san, did you see 
this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wearing an unusually fearless grin, 
Kawakami Princess showed me a certain 
video.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'A promising bud blossoms in brilliant 
color—'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Beginning with the Oka Sho, the stage 
where graceful Umamusume clash... The 
Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The blossoms advance to their next 
battle, the Oaks, in pursuit of the tiara 
of the 'Queen of the Oaks.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“‘A battle befitting a queen. Behold me, 
everyone, as your queen... they say.’”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "HOWEVERRR!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And bursting onto the scene is the 
explosive... no, the ferocious Umamusume! 
Kawakami Princess is sweeping away all 
before her!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Smashing through every door and wall in 
her way! The princess enters the frayyy!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Right?♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, apparently this is a special video 
made by the TV station crew who came to 
the press conference the other day!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it feel like I'm the star of this 
race? Don't you agree, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It ended up with a slightly... no, a 
vastly different atmosphere compared to 
any past footage from the "Oaks."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In this Oaks, I shall grace you all by 
becoming the runaway heroine♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Just as PriFigh grew stronger by wearing a 
special crown, I'll be claiming crowns 
left and right on the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here comes this Umamusume as well! 
Kawakami Princess!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess acts with elegance and 
audacity! I shall seize victory with my 
own hands!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Big Sis, your pose looks so cool! 
Just like in PreFy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Yes, yes. After all, I am a 
princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please watch to your heart's 
content! Watch me claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Girls
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah♪

text_block_list.name: Braided Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Good luck, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
! That girl is... And the one next to her 
is—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (I see, so you've grown stronger too...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(You've made him your henchman... or 
rather, your companion, haven't you!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, now then. The curtain rises on the 
legend of the princess!
